context: An elderly couple debates a weekend invitation
purpose: Teach: 易い/あらわれ/混じっ/密か/つねに/ぜひとも/すむ/誘惑

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫から週末の同窓会に来てくれって誘いがあったんだが、行くべきか密かに迷っておるんだ。
lines.en: Our grandson invited us to the weekend reunion, and I've been secretly wavering about going.
lines.style: Hesitant elderly husband sharing a private worry

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あらまあ、あなたはつねに最初は渋るのよね。行けば楽しいに決まってるじゃない。
lines.en: Oh my, you're always reluctant at first. Of course it'll be fun once we go.
lines.style: Warm grandmother teasing her hesitant husband gently

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: しかしな、あの長い電車移動は若い頃ほど楽じゃない。乗り換えもややこしくて、使い易い駅とは言えんしな。
lines.en: But that long train ride isn't as easy as in our youth. The transfers are confusing too — hardly what you'd call an easy-to-use station.
lines.style: Practical elderly man citing physical concerns and grumbling

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫がぜひとも来てほしいって電話で言ってくれたのよ。その気持ちに応えてあげましょうよ。
lines.en: Our grandson called and said he really wanted us there. Let's respond to that sentiment.
lines.style: Persuasive grandmother appealing to family bonds warmly

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 確かに、孫の嬉しそうな顔が思い浮かぶと、断る理由なんて消えてしまうな。
lines.en: True, when our grandson's happy face comes to mind, every reason to refuse just vanishes.
lines.style: Softening elderly husband moved by family affection

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それにね、向こうのお寿司屋さん、誘惑に勝てなくてまた食べたいって思ってたでしょう?
lines.en: Besides, that sushi place over there — you couldn't resist the temptation and wanted to eat there again, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing grandmother playfully exposing his cravings

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うぬ、見抜かれておったか。あの大トロは脂に旨味が混じっておって、忘れられん味じゃ。
lines.en: Hmph, you saw through me. That fatty tuna had umami blended into the fat — an unforgettable taste.
lines.style: Sheepish elderly husband admitting his weakness fondly

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 胸の奥にずっと未練があらわれてたのね。じゃあ決まり、行きましょうよ。
lines.en: So that lingering attachment had been showing in your heart all along. Then it's settled — let's go.
lines.style: Affectionate grandmother gently sealing the decision

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 用事がすむのを待って荷造りしておくから、あなたは切符の手配をお願いね。
lines.en: I'll wait for the errands to finish and then pack, so please handle the tickets.
lines.style: Decisive grandmother organizing the trip practically now
